title: Homebox
summary: Browse and manage home-inventory items, locations, tags and entity types through the Homebox REST API, exposed as a narrow MCP surface with read-only and full-access variants.

review.notes: Compatibility reviewed against the Homebox REST API in 0.26.2. Operations cover the reviewed subset only; the upstream OpenAPI document is not redistributed here.

secrets.name: HOMEBOX_TOKEN
secrets.description: A Homebox API key created under the user's profile (normally prefixed 'hb_'). Sent as the Authorization bearer for /api requests.

provenance.notes: The Manifest was authored by MCPiler from the reviewed API behaviour; no upstream specification text is copied.
